files.CHANGELOG.md:
# anvil-relay changelog

Every entry is tagged with its channel. Builds tagged preview are confined to
the sandbox estate; builds tagged shipped are the ones customers run.

## 5.0.0-rc.3 - preview - 2026-09-02

- Rework the reconnect backoff and expose the attempt count.
- Emit a structured connect record for every broker handshake.

## 4.8.1 - shipped - 2026-07-21

- Fix a stall when the broker sends an empty frame.
- Pin the TLS profile to 1.3.

## 4.8.0 - shipped - 2026-05-30

- Add the relay health endpoint used by the plant dashboard.
files.README.md:
# anvil-relay

anvil-relay is the connector between the plant estate and the Anvil broker.
Each plant runs one relay per line controller.

Release channels are recorded in CHANGELOG.md. The tuning notes for the relay
fleet are in docs/relay-tuning.md.
files.docs/relay-tuning.md:
# Relay tuning notes

Backoff grows from 200 ms and is capped at 30 s. A relay that exceeds the four
second handler budget is recycled by the supervisor.

Owner: Kadir Petrov (plant platform), desk 1180.
